title: B-roll lower third over a synthetic presenter
caption: The broll-lower-third recipe: a quiet name and affiliation plate with an accent line, 80 px in from the bottom-left corner and clear of the speaker's face, rendered transparent for any footage.
prompt: I have a talking-head clip (synthetic here: make it with node make-footage.mjs, presenter right of centre). Add a lower third in the broll-lower-third style for 4.5 seconds, starting after one second: "Elena Petrova", "Social media lead, Magnifito". She is a fictional presenter, so record the name and role in claims.json as placeholders. Render it transparent and lay it over the footage, bottom-left, clear of her face. Brand: dark ink plate, cream text, green #8acf31 accent line, Geist from fonts/.
commands: ffmpeg -i work/source.mp4 -itsoffset 1.0 -i work/overlay.mov -filter_complex "[0:v][1:v]overlay=eof_action=pass:format=auto,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -map 0:a -t 6 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/broll-lower-third.mp4
credits: Geist typeface by Vercel, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (fonts/OFL-Geist.txt); TTF converted from the WOFF2 vendored in vendor/barty-motion-graphics
Presenter, room and voice-like tone track generated by make-footage.mjs and presenter.mjs (no third-party media)
